content.title: Parks, Trails, and Open Space
content.summary: The City of Arvada oversees a 4,200-acre system of parks, open spaces, and trails, which includes over 90 neighborhood parks accessible to 96% of residents within a ten-minute walk. The Parks Maintenance Team, consisting of 55 professionals, aims to maintain high standards for parks and open spaces, while the city also features a 150-mile trail network for recreation and commuting. Additionally, the Arvada-Blunn Reservoir operates seasonally, and various community events, such as Arbor Day celebrations and fishing contests, are organized to engage residents.
content.body:
The City of Arvada manages a 4,200-acre system of parks, open spaces, and trails guided by the [Arvada Park System Master Plan](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=68c0b26db9532). The parks system includes more than 90 neighborhood parks, one within a ten-minute walk of 96% of residents in our community.

## Parks

The City of Arvada's Parks Maintenance Team is made up of 55 skilled professionals who are dedicated to delivering superior services that enhance the lives of everyone in our community.

The goal of the City's Parks Maintenance team is to maintain the highest parks and open space standards possible making the best use of City resources in a sustainable, equitable and consistent fashion.

- [Park Maintenance](/523)
- [Park Pavilion Rentals](/518)
- [Parks and Urban Design (Park Projects)](/519)
- [Parks Maintenance FAQs](https://www.arvadaco.gov/Faq.aspx?TID=42)

## Trails and Open Space

Arvada's 150-mile trail network consists of primary, regional and local trails with both paved and soft surfaces. Our trails are suitable for recreational enjoyment and commuting.

- [Trails and Open Space Information](/557)
- [Open Space and Natural Area Maintenance](/517)
- [Adopt-a-Trail](/564)
- [Snow Clearing Routes](/565)
- [Trails map](/DocumentCenter/View/793)
- [Trail Etiquette and Tips](/910)

## Arvada-Blunn Reservoir

The Arvada-Blunn Reservoir is located between Highway 93 and W. 64th Parkway. The reservoir is open daily from April 1 through Oct. 31.

- [Reservoir hours and dates of operation](/658)
- [Purchase Reservoir passes](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog)
- [Reservoir Rangers volunteer program](/510)

## Parks and Urban Design

The City of Arvada's Park and Urban Design team directs the planning, land acquisition, design and construction of new parks, trail system, and preservation of open space areas throughout the city.

- [Parks and Urban Design projects](/519)
- [Taking Lasting Care (TLC) program](/860)
- [Guidance and Planning Documents](/880)

## Trees and Urban Forestry

Trees are a major part of the City's infrastructure, providing natural beauty while supporting vital ecosystems. Visit the [trees and urban forestry page](/710) to learn more about the City's Forestry Team or click on one of the topics below.

- [Trees on City Property](/737)
- [Plant-a-Tree Program](/730)
- [Arbor Day Tree Planting](/724)

## Learn More

Listen to the Inside Arvada podcast episode with Parks Manager Steve Gustafson using the player below. During the interview, Steve shares insights about funding, staffing the collaborative partnership and distinctions between Arvada Parks and Apex Park and Recreation District.

You can also listen on [Apple](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/park-and-recreation-month-with-steve-gustafson/id1736238466?i=1000716481438), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/10fRm7IqkxeVdQGdiw8vlC?si=0TI7tUgeSlSWkQIjC2hxuw), [YouTube](https://youtu.be/7i4Oqxz_5Vo?feature=shared) or wherever you listen to podcasts, including [Buzzsprout](https://www.buzzsprout.com/2320363/episodes/17409730) (with transcript).
